face_visibility.value: front-facing (en face), forehead must be exposed and visible; photo must truthfully depict the person

headwear_policy.value: not allowed (hats, caps, scarves); religious or medical head coverings permitted if cheeks, chin and forehead remain visible

size.evidence: The official Croatian Ministry of Interior (mup.gov.hr) page directly states: 'za putovnicu, diplomatsku i sluzbenu putovnicu 35 x 45 mm' (for passport, diplomatic and official passport 35 x 45 mm). This was successfully fetched and confirmed. Multiple independent third-party sources (visafoto.com, idphotodiy.com, 123passportphoto.com, ozelu.com) also consistently cite 35x45mm for Croatian passports.
